# Brigade

> Brigade is a free, open-source app that runs Claude Code agents on your GitHub issues: they open, review and merge pull requests and ask you only for product decisions.

It needs a GitHub repository and a Claude subscription. It is MIT licensed and charges nothing.

- [Home](https://benomite.github.io/brigade/): what Brigade does and how it works
- [Pricing](https://benomite.github.io/brigade/tarifs.html): what is paid, and to whom
- [FAQ](https://benomite.github.io/brigade/faq.html): what it is, who it is for, what it costs and needs, how it differs from alternatives
- [Install steps](https://benomite.github.io/brigade/#install): install Brigade and cook a first ticket
- [README](https://github.com/benomite/brigade/blob/main/README.md): overview in the repository
- [Documentation](https://github.com/benomite/brigade/blob/main/docs/index.md): the full docs
- [Repository](https://github.com/benomite/brigade): source code and releases
